label: lem:strongly_measurable_interior
title: Strong measurability at interior points
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$ and $x \in (\min(a,b), \max(a,b))$, then $f$ is strongly measurable at the neighborhood filter of $x$. This follows via \texttt{ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter} since $x$ lies in the open set $\mathrm{Ioo}\;(\min\,a\,b)\;(\max\,a\,b)$.
proof: Apply \texttt{ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter} with \texttt{isOpen\_Ioo}, since $x$ lies in the open interior.
